🗿 Ladies, please. Allow me to clean them all, from the servants' to the mistresses' chambers.

But, yo... if fairies do piss and poop, do you think they ~~smell like flowe~~ ***\*BONK***- have magical properties? 🤔 Maybe fairy maids was Patchouli's idea? To collect their magical essences, including "waste"?
